item.title: France confirms data breach at government agency that manages citizens' IDs
item.description:
📝 In Brief Posted: 12:34 PM PDT · April 22, 2026 Image Credits:Bastien Ohier / Hans Lucas / AFP / Getty Images Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai France confirms data breach at government agency that manages citizens’ IDs The French government agency that handles the issuing and management of citizens’ identity documents, including national IDs, passports, and immigration documents, confirmed Wednesday that it experienced a data breach. But some reporting suggests millions may have had some of their personal information stolen. item.title: If America's So Rich, How'd It Get So Sad?
item.description:
